excluded.2025: FHZ has no 2025 data; an RHZ-only year is not comparable

masking.rule: score only where value is not NaN AND <pollutant>_filled is False
masking.why: gaps of up to 3 h were linearly interpolated during dataset build; scoring against them measures our own interpolation, not the model

metric_note: MAE and RMSE are per pollutant, in native units, and must never be averaged across pollutants - CO is mg/m3 and the rest are ug/m3. MASE is the only cross-pollutant summary.
